summary: Mentor can now tell you in simple words what each update brings, and its version reads like a date.
Mentor Settings has an Updates tab: every update this Mentor had, and Ask Mentor to go over one with you.
Mentor now warns you and asks first before it restarts to install an update.
In Mentor Settings, Updates, the list of updates is sorted by year and month.
Mentor Settings now uses the whole width of the window, like the Recipes app.
When something does not work as expected, you can tell Mentor's maker: right-click the desktop, Report a problem.
A shorter desktop menu, and the bell's suggestions now have their own tab in Mentor Settings.
In the Recipes app, switching a recipe off only switches it off, and a widget's switch works at once.
Every card in the chat can now be talked about, update cards no longer pop up, and switching a recipe off asks first.
Mentor Settings is back in the desktop menu, next to Settings, and the menu now stays exactly as it is.
Mentor Settings has its own icon: the Mentor owl.
Mentor's self-check now also makes sure Mentor keeps getting its updates.
The bell now has More buttons for more GitHub projects, apps and news, from more sources. History shows the question each answer was for.
The gear now turns while Mentor works on your request, and the bell opens narrow when it has no cards.
Make the chat's text larger or smaller with Ctrl and the mouse wheel (or Ctrl + + − 0); the cards widen with it, and Mentor remembers the size.
Mouse-look now works in 3D games: Mentor switches to a game mouse by itself while a game is in front. The Recipes app can delete a recipe.
